newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Mauritius sells T-bills worth $21.66 million.
newsitem.headline: Mauritius sells T-bills worth $21.66 million.

text.p: The Bank of Mauritius sold all 450 million rupees ($21.66 million) worth of treasury bills at its weekly auction, the central bank said on Thursday.
The central bank sold 91-day bills worth 143.0 million rupees at a weighted average yield of 8.31 percent at the Thursday auction against 110.0 million rupees at 8.69 percent last week.

The bank sold 182-day bills worth 96.0 million rupees with an average yield of 8.38 percent against 115.0 million rupees at 8.75 percent last week and 364-day bills worth 211.0 million rupees at an average yield of 8.35 percent against 175.0 million rupees at 8.92 percent last week.
This week's effective bank rate was posted at 8.34 percent per annum from 8.81 percent last week, the bank said.
